graph_domains.name: Waste Stream Acceptance, Routing and Economics (hazardous waste network)
expected_sources: Finance: price book, costs, lanes, fees, invoices
graph_domains.note: Profiles, permitted codes, capacity bookings, manifests, cost rates and the price book are connected and profiled; policies, permits, requirements and the lab report are in Drive.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No profile or manifest source connected.

graph_domains.name: Compliance, Permits and Transfer
graph_domains.note: Permitted codes, holds, discrepancies and approvals resolve. Permit conditions are summaries in Drive, not a table.

graph_domains.name: Pricing, Margin and Capacity
graph_domains.note: Price book, quotes, costs, lanes, fees, invoices and bookings resolve. Port Terrell's first-quarter 2027 plan is not published, and the legacy prices are the acquired companies' books.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No cost or price source connected.

graph_domains.name: Logistics and Shipment Tracking
graph_domains.note: Carrier tracking is not connected, so where a truck is and when it arrives cannot be read. Arrival questions are declined; the manifest's expected date is answered instead.

graph_personas.name: Director of Technical Solutions
graph_personas.focus: Owns the Technical Solutions desk. Asks whether every accepted stream has an outlet with capacity, where new volume should go, and what goes to the Capacity Committee.

graph_personas.name: Vice President, Sales (Capacity Committee chair)
graph_personas.focus: Chairs the Capacity Committee and signs contracts above $2M. Asks what a proposal earns, what capacity it rests on, and how revenue compares with the plan.

graph_personas.name: Account Manager
graph_personas.focus: Owns the generator relationship. Asks what a stream will be priced at, which facility it goes to, what the customer requires, and how long the quote takes.

graph_personas.name: Approval Chemist
graph_personas.focus: Approves profiles at a facility. Asks whether a waste is understood, whether its codes are on the permit for the unit, and what the laboratory released.

graph_personas.name: Plant Manager, Incineration
graph_personas.focus: Runs an incinerator. Asks what is booked against the unit's capacity, what headroom is left, and what an outage strands.

graph_personas.name: Customer Solutions Coordinator
graph_personas.focus: Runs a service center. Asks which shipments are on the pad, how long, and where each one goes next.

graph_personas.name: Director of Compliance
graph_personas.focus: Owns permits and compliance. Asks which permits are up for renewal, which conditions bind a routing, and whether a generator can ship.

graph_personas.name: Pricing and Margin Manager
graph_personas.focus: Owns the price book and the floor. Asks what each stream earns on full cost, which contracts are under the floor, and what a fee change does.

graph_personas.name: Laboratory Manager
graph_personas.focus: Runs the laboratory. Asks which results are released, which profiles wait on a result, and where the lab and the profile disagree.

graph_personas.name: Transportation Manager
graph_personas.focus: Moves the waste. Asks what a re-route costs on the rate card, which lanes carry the most tons, and what trucks are needed.

graph_personas.name: Third-Party Approvals Lead
graph_personas.focus: Keeps the outside outlets approved. Asks which approvals expire, what the outlets cost, and which streams depend on them.

graph_personas.name: Landfill Program Manager
graph_personas.focus: Runs the secure landfill. Asks what arrives stabilized and compliant, and how much airspace the bookings use.

graph_personas.name: Business President
graph_personas.focus: Runs one of the three businesses. Asks what the business earns, at which facilities, and how it compares with the plan.

graph_personas.name: Chief Financial Officer
graph_personas.focus: Asks revenue against plan, margin by business and facility, and what third-party outlets cost.

graph_personas.name: Internal Audit
graph_personas.focus: Tests the acceptance and pricing controls. Asks how many profiles were approved on unreleased results and how many quotes went below the book.

graph_personas.name: Integration Lead, Acquisitions
graph_personas.focus: Brings the acquired companies in. Asks how many profiles are still on the legacy system and which have been reviewed.

graph_personas.name: Environmental Health and Safety Manager
graph_personas.focus: Keeps receipts safe. Asks which generators send off-spec loads and which discrepancies repeat.

graph_hero_questions.text: What did we invoice this year by business, against the plan, and at what margin?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across fin.invoice_line + fin.revenue_plan + ops.facility at high confidence (0.94).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT i.business_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS period, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, ANY_VALUE(r.plan_usd) AS plan
FROM fin.invoice_line i
JOIN fin.revenue_plan r ON r.business_code = i.business_code AND r.period = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_hero_questions.text: Which units are booked above 90% of capacity for the fourth quarter?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.capacity_booking + ops.process_unit at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.booked_tons) AS booked, SUM(b.capacity_tons) AS capacity, SUM(b.booked_tons) / SUM(b.capacity_tons) AS share
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week BETWEEN 40 AND 52
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY share DESC

graph_hero_questions.text: Which approved profiles are under the 15% stream floor at today's fees?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + fin.treatment_cost + fin.transport_lane + fin.state_fee at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, p.price_usd_ton, fc.full_cost_usd_ton, (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM ops.waste_profile p
JOIN full_cost fc ON fc.facility_code = p.facility_code AND fc.process_code = p.process_code AND fc.origin_region = (SELECT origin_region FROM ops.generator g WHERE g.generator_id = p.generator_id)
WHERE p.status = 'Approved' AND (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton < 0.15

graph_hero_questions.text: What do third-party outlets cost us this year, and which approvals expire next?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.third_party_manifest + ops.third_party_approval at high confidence (0.91).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT t.outlet_id, SUM(t.tons) AS tons, SUM(t.cost_usd) AS cost
FROM ops.third_party_manifest t
GROUP BY 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which generators send the most off-spec loads?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.receipt_discrepancy + ops.generator at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT m.generator_id, COUNTIF(m.off_spec) / COUNT(*) AS off_spec_rate, COUNT(*) AS receipts
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING receipts >= 20
ORDER BY off_spec_rate DESC

graph_hero_questions.text: How many shipments exceeded the ten-day transfer limit this year, and at which service centers?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.transfer_hold + ops.facility at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT h.center_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', h.arrived_on) AS month, COUNTIF(h.exceeded_ten_days) AS exceeded, COUNT(*) AS holds
FROM ops.transfer_hold h
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_hero_questions.text: Which profiles are pending approval, and which of them are waiting on a laboratory result?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + ops.profile_analytical at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), p.received_on, DAY) AS days_pending, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.profile_analytical a WHERE a.profile_id = p.profile_id AND a.released_on IS NOT NULL) AS result_released
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.status = 'Pending'

graph_hero_questions.text: What is booked against the capacity of each incineration unit, and what headroom is left in November?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.capacity_booking + ops.process_unit at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.capacity_tons - b.booked_tons) AS headroom_tons
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week IN (45, 46) AND NOT b.outage
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_hero_questions.text: What is the margin by facility and unit this year?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across fin.invoice_line + ops.facility at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT i.facility_code, i.process_code, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY margin_pct

graph_hero_questions.text: Which units could take each of the six Halden streams under their permits?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.facility_permit_code + ops.process_unit + the Halden profiles at high confidence (0.9); customer requirements read from QR-14 in Drive.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code
FROM ops.process_unit u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(:codes, ',')) c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.facility_permit_code pc WHERE pc.facility_code = u.facility_code AND pc.process_code = u.process_code AND pc.waste_code = c))

graph_hero_questions.text: What does the Port Terrell outage strand, and where can each shipment go?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.capacity_booking + ops.facility_permit_code + ops.transfer_hold at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, m.generator_id, m.facility_code, m.process_code, m.tons, m.eta
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND (b.outage OR b.booked_tons > b.capacity_tons)

graph_hero_questions.text: How long does a profile take from receipt to approval?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile at medium confidence (0.8): receipt dates are carried for profiles received since 2025.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(p.approved_on, QUARTER) AS quarter, APPROX_QUANTILES(DATE_DIFF(p.approved_on, p.received_on, DAY), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_days
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.approved_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which third-party approvals expire in the next 60 days, and which streams depend on them?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.third_party_approval + ops.waste_profile at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT a.outlet_id, a.profile_id, a.generator_id, a.expires_on, a.cost_usd_ton
FROM ops.third_party_approval a
WHERE a.expires_on BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)

graph_hero_questions.text: What does a re-route from Port Terrell to Granger cost a ton on the rate card, by origin region?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across fin.transport_lane + fin.treatment_cost + fin.state_fee at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, (fc_alt.full_cost_usd_ton - fc_now.full_cost_usd_ton) * m.tons AS extra_cost_usd
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN full_cost fc_now ON fc_now.facility_code = m.facility_code AND fc_now.process_code = m.process_code
JOIN full_cost fc_alt ON fc_alt.facility_code = :alt_facility AND fc_alt.process_code = m.process_code

graph_hero_questions.text: Which shipments are on the pad at Galena Shores today, and when does each one's clock run out?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.transfer_hold + ops.manifest at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT h.manifest_id, h.center_code, h.arrived_on, h.days_held, h.deadline
FROM ops.transfer_hold h
WHERE h.left_on IS NULL
ORDER BY h.deadline

graph_hero_questions.text: How many Harbor Line and Tidewater profiles are still on the legacy system, and how many has a chemist reviewed?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across legacy.legacy_profile + ops.waste_profile at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT l.source_company, COUNT(*) AS profiles, COUNTIF(l.reviewed) AS reviewed
FROM legacy.legacy_profile l
GROUP BY 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which approved profiles expire in the next 90 days, and what revenue rides on them?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + ops.generator at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, p.expires_on, p.annual_tons * p.price_usd_ton AS annual_revenue
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.status = 'Approved' AND p.expires_on BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

graph_hero_questions.text: What would the six Halden streams earn a year by route, at the price book, on full cost?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across the Halden profiles + fin.price_book + fin.treatment_cost + fin.transport_lane + fin.state_fee at high confidence (0.88); capacity notes from ops.capacity_booking.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT q.profile_id, q.facility_code, q.process_code, q.price_usd_ton, (q.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / q.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM fin.quote_line q
JOIN full_cost fc USING (facility_code, process_code)

graph_hero_questions.text: Can Port Terrell carry the Halden process wastewater in the first quarter, on what is booked today?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.capacity_booking + ops.process_unit at medium confidence (0.82): the first-quarter plan is not published; the fourth quarter is repeated.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.capacity_tons - b.booked_tons) AS headroom_tons
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week IN (45, 46) AND NOT b.outage
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_hero_questions.text: Which of the six Halden streams meet the destruction requirement at which units, and which outlets are ruled out by it?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.facility_permit_code + the Halden profiles + QR-14 and the Bayou Verde permit summary in Drive at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code
FROM ops.process_unit u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(:codes, ',')) c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.facility_permit_code pc WHERE pc.facility_code = u.facility_code AND pc.process_code = u.process_code AND pc.waste_code = c))

graph_hero_questions.text: Which Halden streams carry a laboratory finding the profile did not say?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.profile_analytical + ops.waste_profile at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', a.sampled_on) AS month, APPROX_QUANTILES(DATE_DIFF(a.released_on, a.sampled_on, DAY), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_days
FROM ops.profile_analytical a
GROUP BY 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which quotes this year were priced below the price book, and by how much?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across fin.quote_line + fin.price_book at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT ql.quote_id, ql.profile_id, ql.price_usd_ton, ql.book_price_usd_ton, 1 - ql.price_usd_ton / ql.book_price_usd_ton AS discount
FROM fin.quote_line ql
WHERE ql.price_usd_ton < ql.book_price_usd_ton

graph_hero_questions.text: How many profiles were approved before their laboratory result was released?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + ops.profile_analytical at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.approved_on, MIN(a.released_on) AS first_release
FROM ops.waste_profile p
JOIN ops.profile_analytical a USING (profile_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING p.approved_on < first_release

graph_hero_questions.text: What is our quote turnaround, and how many quotes went out after the date the customer asked for?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across fin.quote at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(q.issued_on, QUARTER) AS quarter, AVG(q.turnaround_days) AS avg_days, COUNTIF(q.issued_on > q.due_on) AS late
FROM fin.quote q
WHERE q.issued_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which permits and outlet approvals come up for decision in the next 90 days?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.process_unit + ops.third_party_outlet + the compliance notes in Drive at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT 'facility' AS kind, f.facility_code AS id, f.unit_note AS note FROM ops.process_unit f WHERE f.unit_note LIKE '%renewal%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'outlet', t.outlet_id, CAST(t.approval_expires_on AS STRING) FROM ops.third_party_outlet t WHERE t.approval_expires_on <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

graph_hero_questions.text: What does the 1 November fee rise do to margin, and which contracts carry the pass-through clause?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across fin.state_fee + ops.manifest + ops.facility at medium confidence (0.84): the pass-through clause is read from the contract files, not a column.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT fa.state, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, ANY_VALUE(f_new.fee_usd_ton - f_old.fee_usd_ton) AS fee_change
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.facility fa USING (facility_code)
JOIN fin.state_fee f_old ON f_old.state = fa.state AND f_old.valid_to IS NOT NULL
JOIN fin.state_fee f_new ON f_new.state = fa.state AND f_new.valid_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 1

graph_hero_questions.text: How much has gone to third-party outlets this year, by outlet, and what did it cost above our own units?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.third_party_manifest + ops.third_party_outlet at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT t.outlet_id, SUM(t.tons) AS tons, SUM(t.cost_usd) AS cost
FROM ops.third_party_manifest t
GROUP BY 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which generators pay different prices for the same process?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + fin.price_book at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT i.generator_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC

graph_hero_questions.text: Which lanes carry the most tons, and what do they cost a ton?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.generator + fin.transport_lane at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT g.origin_region, m.facility_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, ANY_VALUE(l.rate_usd_ton) AS rate, ANY_VALUE(l.loaded_miles) AS miles
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.generator g USING (generator_id)
JOIN fin.transport_lane l ON l.origin_region = g.origin_region AND l.facility_code = m.facility_code
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_hero_questions.text: Where is the Halford Retail Services tanker right now?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: carrier tracking is not connected; the manifest's expected arrival is answered instead.

graph_hero_questions.text: What has Cypress Landing taken since it opened, against its permitted capacity?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.process_unit at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT m.process_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.facility_code = 'CYP' AND m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which generators are our largest by revenue this year, and at what margin?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across fin.invoice_line + ops.generator at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT i.generator_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC

graph_hero_questions.text: Which waste codes do we receive the most of, and at which units?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.waste_profile at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT c AS waste_code, m.process_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.waste_profile p USING (profile_id), UNNEST(SPLIT(p.waste_codes, ',')) c
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_hero_questions.text: What does the legacy price book charge against our 2026 price book for the same processes?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across legacy.legacy_profile + fin.price_book at high confidence (0.88).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT l.ironbridge_profile_id, l.legacy_price_usd_ton, b.price_usd_ton AS book, l.legacy_price_usd_ton / b.price_usd_ton - 1 AS gap
FROM legacy.legacy_profile l
JOIN ops.waste_profile p ON p.profile_id = l.ironbridge_profile_id
JOIN fin.price_book b ON b.process_code = p.process_code

graph_hero_questions.text: What will competitors quote Halden for the process wastewater?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: competitor and market pricing are not in any connected source.

graph_hero_questions.text: What is each business's revenue by facility this year?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across fin.invoice_line + ops.facility at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT i.business_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS period, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, ANY_VALUE(r.plan_usd) AS plan
FROM fin.invoice_line i
JOIN fin.revenue_plan r ON r.business_code = i.business_code AND r.period = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_hero_questions.text: If the Port Terrell outage runs a week longer, which further shipments lose their outlet?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.capacity_booking at medium confidence (0.8): it extends the outage weeks and reads the bookings.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, m.generator_id, m.facility_code, m.process_code, m.tons, m.eta
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND (b.outage OR b.booked_tons > b.capacity_tons)

graph_hero_questions.text: Is the Halden solvent waste acceptable at Fox Hollow for fuel blending?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.process_unit + ops.profile_analytical + the fuel blending limits note in Drive at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code
FROM ops.process_unit u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(:codes, ',')) c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.facility_permit_code pc WHERE pc.facility_code = u.facility_code AND pc.process_code = u.process_code AND pc.waste_code = c))

graph_hero_questions.text: What will the Texas disposal fee be in 2027?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: the graph holds the fee schedule in force, not legislation to come.

graph_hero_questions.text: Will Halden sign if we quote Granger instead of Port Terrell?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: the graph does not predict a customer's decision; what Halden asked for is answered instead.

graph_hero_questions.text: Has the Riverbend laboratory released the Halden results?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.profile_analytical at high confidence (0.95).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT a.profile_id, a.parameter, a.value, a.unit, a.released_on
FROM ops.profile_analytical a
JOIN ops.waste_profile p USING (profile_id)
WHERE p.generator_id = 'G11100'

graph_hero_questions.text: Is the Halden process wastewater RCRA hazardous under Texas rules without a TCLP result?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: a classification needs the released result; the profile's stated codes and the released results are answered instead.

graph_hero_questions.text: What does Priya need for the Halden proposal by Friday, and what is ready?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across the mailbox (thread A1) and the proposal folder at medium confidence (0.84).

graph_hero_questions.text: Which units are down or over capacity this week, and what is booked to them?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.capacity_booking + ops.manifest at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT m.facility_code, COUNT(*) AS manifests, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, SUM(m.revenue_usd) AS revenue
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND b.outage
GROUP BY 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which incinerator will fail next?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: equipment condition and failure history are not connected, and the graph does not predict failures.

graph_use_cases.name: Waste Stream Analyst · Ironbridge Environmental Services
graph_use_cases.business_need: Waste Stream Analyst for Ironbridge Environmental Services' three businesses (Midwest, Gulf, East) and its thirteen facilities. Characterises and classifies every new waste stream, routes it through permits and capacity to the unit that earns the margin, prices it from the price book on full cost, keeps every accepted stream with a permitted, in-capacity outlet, and reports to the Capacity Committee. Reports to dana.whitfield@vriodigital.com.

personas.name: Director of Technical Solutions
personas.description: Owns the Technical Solutions desk. Asks whether every accepted stream has an outlet with capacity, where new volume should go, and what goes to the Capacity Committee.

personas.name: Vice President, Sales (Capacity Committee chair)
personas.description: Chairs the Capacity Committee and signs contracts above $2M. Asks what a proposal earns, what capacity it rests on, and how revenue compares with the plan.

personas.name: Account Manager
personas.description: Owns the generator relationship. Asks what a stream will be priced at, which facility it goes to, what the customer requires, and how long the quote takes.

personas.name: Approval Chemist
personas.description: Approves profiles at a facility. Asks whether a waste is understood, whether its codes are on the permit for the unit, and what the laboratory released.

personas.name: Plant Manager, Incineration
personas.description: Runs an incinerator. Asks what is booked against the unit's capacity, what headroom is left, and what an outage strands.

personas.name: Customer Solutions Coordinator
personas.description: Runs a service center. Asks which shipments are on the pad, how long, and where each one goes next.

personas.name: Director of Compliance
personas.description: Owns permits and compliance. Asks which permits are up for renewal, which conditions bind a routing, and whether a generator can ship.

personas.name: Pricing and Margin Manager
personas.description: Owns the price book and the floor. Asks what each stream earns on full cost, which contracts are under the floor, and what a fee change does.

personas.name: Transportation Manager
personas.description: Moves the waste. Asks what a re-route costs on the rate card, which lanes carry the most tons, and what trucks are needed.

personas.name: Third-Party Approvals Lead
personas.description: Keeps the outside outlets approved. Asks which approvals expire, what the outlets cost, and which streams depend on them.

metrics.name: Capacity booked against permitted
metrics.description: Tons booked in the quarter as a share of the unit's capacity for the quarter (permitted tons a year divided by 52, times the weeks), by facility and unit.
metrics.sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.booked_tons) AS booked, SUM(b.capacity_tons) AS capacity, SUM(b.booked_tons) / SUM(b.capacity_tons) AS share
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week BETWEEN 40 AND 52
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY share DESC

metrics.name: Unit headroom for a period
metrics.description: Capacity minus booked tons for the weeks in the period, by facility and unit.
metrics.sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.capacity_tons - b.booked_tons) AS headroom_tons
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week IN (45, 46) AND NOT b.outage
GROUP BY 1, 2

metrics.name: Permitted outlets for a stream
metrics.description: Units at which every waste code on the profile is permitted and the physical form is accepted; with capacity in the period, an outlet.
metrics.sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code
FROM ops.process_unit u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(:codes, ',')) c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.facility_permit_code pc WHERE pc.facility_code = u.facility_code AND pc.process_code = u.process_code AND pc.waste_code = c))

metrics.name: Full cost a ton by route
metrics.description: Treatment cost plus handling plus the receiving state's fee plus the transport lane from the origin region, a ton, for a stream at a unit.
metrics.sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code, t.cost_usd_ton + p.handling_usd_ton + f.fee_usd_ton + l.rate_usd_ton AS full_cost_usd_ton
FROM ops.process_unit u
JOIN fin.treatment_cost t USING (facility_code, process_code)
JOIN fin.price_book p USING (process_code)
JOIN ops.facility fa USING (facility_code)
JOIN fin.state_fee f ON f.state = fa.state AND f.valid_to IS NULL
JOIN fin.transport_lane l ON l.facility_code = u.facility_code AND l.origin_region = :origin

metrics.name: Margin a ton by stream and route
metrics.description: Price a ton minus full cost a ton, as a share of price, for a stream at its quoted route.
metrics.sql:
SELECT q.profile_id, q.facility_code, q.process_code, q.price_usd_ton, (q.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / q.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM fin.quote_line q
JOIN full_cost fc USING (facility_code, process_code)

metrics.name: Contract margin on full cost
metrics.description: Revenue minus full cost over all a generator's streams, as a share of revenue, against the 28% floor.
metrics.sql:
SELECT i.generator_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, SUM(i.full_cost_usd) AS full_cost, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
WHERE i.invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY i.generator_id
HAVING margin_pct < 0.28

metrics.name: Streams below the stream floor
metrics.description: Approved profiles whose margin a ton at the approved route, at today's fees, is below 15%.
metrics.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, p.price_usd_ton, fc.full_cost_usd_ton, (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM ops.waste_profile p
JOIN full_cost fc ON fc.facility_code = p.facility_code AND fc.process_code = p.process_code AND fc.origin_region = (SELECT origin_region FROM ops.generator g WHERE g.generator_id = p.generator_id)
WHERE p.status = 'Approved' AND (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton < 0.15

metrics.name: Profiles pending approval
metrics.description: Profiles in status Pending, with days since receipt and whether a laboratory result is released.
metrics.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), p.received_on, DAY) AS days_pending, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.profile_analytical a WHERE a.profile_id = p.profile_id AND a.released_on IS NOT NULL) AS result_released
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.status = 'Pending'

metrics.name: Manifests without an in-capacity outlet
metrics.description: Open manifests booked to a unit that is down or over capacity in the week of arrival.
metrics.sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, m.generator_id, m.facility_code, m.process_code, m.tons, m.eta
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND (b.outage OR b.booked_tons > b.capacity_tons)

metrics.name: Re-route cost on the rate card
metrics.description: For a manifest, the full cost at an alternative unit minus the full cost at the booked unit, times tons.
metrics.sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, (fc_alt.full_cost_usd_ton - fc_now.full_cost_usd_ton) * m.tons AS extra_cost_usd
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN full_cost fc_now ON fc_now.facility_code = m.facility_code AND fc_now.process_code = m.process_code
JOIN full_cost fc_alt ON fc_alt.facility_code = :alt_facility AND fc_alt.process_code = m.process_code

metrics.name: Third-party outlet spend
metrics.description: Tons and outlet cost sent to third-party outlets this year, by outlet.
metrics.sql:
SELECT t.outlet_id, SUM(t.tons) AS tons, SUM(t.cost_usd) AS cost
FROM ops.third_party_manifest t
GROUP BY 1

metrics.name: Shipments on the pad against their clock
metrics.description: Shipments still at a service center with days held and the tenth-day deadline.
metrics.sql:
SELECT h.manifest_id, h.center_code, h.arrived_on, h.days_held, h.deadline
FROM ops.transfer_hold h
WHERE h.left_on IS NULL
ORDER BY h.deadline

graph_use_case_templates.name: Waste Stream Analyst
graph_use_case_templates.description: One graph over profiles, permitted codes, capacity bookings, manifests, cost rates and the price book across every facility, so a routing question resolves once and states which permit, which booking and which cost it read.

graph_metrics.name: Unit headroom for a period
graph_metrics.definition: Capacity minus booked tons for the weeks in the period, by facility and unit.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.capacity_tons - b.booked_tons) AS headroom_tons

graph_metrics.name: Full cost a ton by route
graph_metrics.definition: Treatment cost plus handling plus the receiving state's fee plus the transport lane from the origin region, a ton, for a stream at a unit.
graph_metrics.sql:

JOIN fin.transport_lane l ON l.facility_code = u.facility_code AND l.origin_region = :origin

graph_metrics.name: Margin a ton by stream and route
graph_metrics.definition: Price a ton minus full cost a ton, as a share of price, for a stream at its quoted route.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT q.profile_id, q.facility_code, q.process_code, q.price_usd_ton, (q.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / q.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM fin.quote_line q
JOIN full_cost fc USING (facility_code, process_code)

graph_metrics.name: Contract margin on full cost
graph_metrics.definition: Revenue minus full cost over all a generator's streams, as a share of revenue, against the 28% floor.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT i.generator_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, SUM(i.full_cost_usd) AS full_cost, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
WHERE i.invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY i.generator_id
HAVING margin_pct < 0.28

graph_metrics.name: Streams below the stream floor
graph_metrics.definition: Approved profiles whose margin a ton at the approved route, at today's fees, is below 15%.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, p.price_usd_ton, fc.full_cost_usd_ton, (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM ops.waste_profile p
JOIN full_cost fc ON fc.facility_code = p.facility_code AND fc.process_code = p.process_code AND fc.origin_region = (SELECT origin_region FROM ops.generator g WHERE g.generator_id = p.generator_id)
WHERE p.status = 'Approved' AND (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton < 0.15

graph_metrics.name: Revenue against plan
graph_metrics.definition: Invoiced revenue by business and month against the FY26 plan for the same months.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT i.business_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS period, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, ANY_VALUE(r.plan_usd) AS plan
FROM fin.invoice_line i
JOIN fin.revenue_plan r ON r.business_code = i.business_code AND r.period = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_metrics.name: Margin by facility and unit
graph_metrics.definition: Revenue minus full cost as a share of revenue, by facility and unit, from invoice lines.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT i.facility_code, i.process_code, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY margin_pct

graph_metrics.name: Profiles pending approval
graph_metrics.definition: Profiles in status Pending, with days since receipt and whether a laboratory result is released.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), p.received_on, DAY) AS days_pending, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.profile_analytical a WHERE a.profile_id = p.profile_id AND a.released_on IS NOT NULL) AS result_released
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.status = 'Pending'

graph_metrics.name: Profiles expiring in 90 days
graph_metrics.definition: Approved profiles whose expiry falls in the next 90 days, with tons a year and revenue at risk.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, p.expires_on, p.annual_tons * p.price_usd_ton AS annual_revenue
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.status = 'Approved' AND p.expires_on BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

graph_metrics.name: Profile approval cycle time
graph_metrics.definition: Days from profile receipt to approval, median and 90th percentile, by quarter.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(p.approved_on, QUARTER) AS quarter, APPROX_QUANTILES(DATE_DIFF(p.approved_on, p.received_on, DAY), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_days
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.approved_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

graph_metrics.name: Profiles approved before the result was released
graph_metrics.definition: Approved profiles whose approval date precedes the release of their laboratory result.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.approved_on, MIN(a.released_on) AS first_release
FROM ops.waste_profile p
JOIN ops.profile_analytical a USING (profile_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING p.approved_on < first_release

graph_metrics.name: Off-spec rate by generator
graph_metrics.definition: Receipt discrepancies as a share of received manifests, by generator, this year.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT m.generator_id, COUNTIF(m.off_spec) / COUNT(*) AS off_spec_rate, COUNT(*) AS receipts
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING receipts >= 20
ORDER BY off_spec_rate DESC

graph_metrics.name: Ten-day transfer exceedances
graph_metrics.definition: Shipments that stayed at a service center more than ten days, by center and month.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT h.center_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', h.arrived_on) AS month, COUNTIF(h.exceeded_ten_days) AS exceeded, COUNT(*) AS holds
FROM ops.transfer_hold h
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_metrics.name: Shipments on the pad against their clock
graph_metrics.definition: Shipments still at a service center with days held and the tenth-day deadline.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT h.manifest_id, h.center_code, h.arrived_on, h.days_held, h.deadline
FROM ops.transfer_hold h
WHERE h.left_on IS NULL
ORDER BY h.deadline

graph_metrics.name: Manifests without an in-capacity outlet
graph_metrics.definition: Open manifests booked to a unit that is down or over capacity in the week of arrival.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, m.generator_id, m.facility_code, m.process_code, m.tons, m.eta
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND (b.outage OR b.booked_tons > b.capacity_tons)

graph_metrics.name: Re-route cost on the rate card
graph_metrics.definition: For a manifest, the full cost at an alternative unit minus the full cost at the booked unit, times tons.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, (fc_alt.full_cost_usd_ton - fc_now.full_cost_usd_ton) * m.tons AS extra_cost_usd
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN full_cost fc_now ON fc_now.facility_code = m.facility_code AND fc_now.process_code = m.process_code
JOIN full_cost fc_alt ON fc_alt.facility_code = :alt_facility AND fc_alt.process_code = m.process_code

graph_metrics.name: Third-party outlet spend
graph_metrics.definition: Tons and outlet cost sent to third-party outlets this year, by outlet.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT t.outlet_id, SUM(t.tons) AS tons, SUM(t.cost_usd) AS cost
FROM ops.third_party_manifest t
GROUP BY 1

graph_metrics.name: Third-party approvals expiring
graph_metrics.definition: Profile approvals at third-party outlets expiring in the next 60 days, with the streams that depend on them.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT a.outlet_id, a.profile_id, a.generator_id, a.expires_on, a.cost_usd_ton
FROM ops.third_party_approval a
WHERE a.expires_on BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)

graph_metrics.name: Profiles on the legacy system
graph_metrics.definition: Profiles still in LegacyTrack, by source company, and how many an Approval Chemist has reviewed.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT l.source_company, COUNT(*) AS profiles, COUNTIF(l.reviewed) AS reviewed
FROM legacy.legacy_profile l
GROUP BY 1

graph_metrics.name: Legacy price against the price book
graph_metrics.definition: The acquired companies' price a ton against the 2026 price book for the same process, by profile.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT l.ironbridge_profile_id, l.legacy_price_usd_ton, b.price_usd_ton AS book, l.legacy_price_usd_ton / b.price_usd_ton - 1 AS gap
FROM legacy.legacy_profile l
JOIN ops.waste_profile p ON p.profile_id = l.ironbridge_profile_id
JOIN fin.price_book b ON b.process_code = p.process_code

graph_metrics.name: Quote turnaround
graph_metrics.definition: Days from request to issue by quarter, and quotes issued after the date the customer asked for.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(q.issued_on, QUARTER) AS quarter, AVG(q.turnaround_days) AS avg_days, COUNTIF(q.issued_on > q.due_on) AS late
FROM fin.quote q
WHERE q.issued_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

graph_metrics.name: Quote win rate
graph_metrics.definition: Quotes won as a share of quotes decided, by quarter and account manager.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT q.owner, COUNTIF(q.status = 'Won') / COUNTIF(q.status IN ('Won', 'Lost')) AS win_rate
FROM fin.quote q
GROUP BY 1

graph_metrics.name: Quoted price against the price book
graph_metrics.definition: Quote lines priced below the price book, with the discount and who approved it.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT ql.quote_id, ql.profile_id, ql.price_usd_ton, ql.book_price_usd_ton, 1 - ql.price_usd_ton / ql.book_price_usd_ton AS discount
FROM fin.quote_line ql
WHERE ql.price_usd_ton < ql.book_price_usd_ton

graph_metrics.name: Tons by waste code
graph_metrics.definition: Tons received this year by waste code and receiving unit.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT c AS waste_code, m.process_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.waste_profile p USING (profile_id), UNNEST(SPLIT(p.waste_codes, ',')) c
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_metrics.name: State fee exposure
graph_metrics.definition: Tons received by state and the fee change from 1 November, split by contracts with and without the pass-through clause.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT fa.state, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, ANY_VALUE(f_new.fee_usd_ton - f_old.fee_usd_ton) AS fee_change
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.facility fa USING (facility_code)
JOIN fin.state_fee f_old ON f_old.state = fa.state AND f_old.valid_to IS NOT NULL
JOIN fin.state_fee f_new ON f_new.state = fa.state AND f_new.valid_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 1

graph_metrics.name: Permits and approvals up for renewal
graph_metrics.definition: Facilities with a permit renewal pending and third-party outlets with an approval expiring in 90 days.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT 'facility' AS kind, f.facility_code AS id, f.unit_note AS note FROM ops.process_unit f WHERE f.unit_note LIKE '%renewal%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'outlet', t.outlet_id, CAST(t.approval_expires_on AS STRING) FROM ops.third_party_outlet t WHERE t.approval_expires_on <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

graph_metrics.name: Tons and revenue stranded by an outage
graph_metrics.definition: Open manifests booked to a unit in outage weeks: tons and revenue.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT m.facility_code, COUNT(*) AS manifests, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, SUM(m.revenue_usd) AS revenue
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND b.outage
GROUP BY 1

graph_metrics.name: Revenue by generator
graph_metrics.definition: Invoiced revenue and margin by generator this year.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT i.generator_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC

graph_metrics.name: Tons by transport lane
graph_metrics.definition: Tons received by origin region and facility, with the lane rate and loaded miles.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT g.origin_region, m.facility_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, ANY_VALUE(l.rate_usd_ton) AS rate, ANY_VALUE(l.loaded_miles) AS miles
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.generator g USING (generator_id)
JOIN fin.transport_lane l ON l.origin_region = g.origin_region AND l.facility_code = m.facility_code
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_metrics.name: Aerosol and cylinder volume
graph_metrics.definition: Tons received at Cypress Landing since it opened, by unit, against its permitted capacity.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT m.process_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.facility_code = 'CYP' AND m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1

graph_metrics.name: Stabilized output against the LDR standard
graph_metrics.definition: Stabilized batches shipped to Millhaven with the treatment standard result on file.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, m.tons
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.facility_code = 'MLN' AND m.status = 'Received'

graph_metrics.name: Days from sample to released result
graph_metrics.definition: Days from sample to release, median by month; profiles waiting on a result.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', a.sampled_on) AS month, APPROX_QUANTILES(DATE_DIFF(a.released_on, a.sampled_on, DAY), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_days
FROM ops.profile_analytical a
GROUP BY 1
